answer: A payout is split so that 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The crystal schedule is applied in umber and nectar exposes each instalment. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4453 identities would post 3828 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
